question_response: Prof. Lee is an outstanding educator. Every lecture felt purposeful and I always left with a deeper understanding of the material.
The way Prof. Lee structures discussions is remarkable. Every student has a voice and no one dominates the conversation.
I felt seen and heard in this class in a way I rarely do. Prof. Lee creates a genuinely inclusive learning environment.
The feedback on assignments was the most detailed and constructive I have received in any course. It actually helped me improve.
Prof. Lee anticipated student questions before they were even asked. The level of preparation and care was extraordinary.
I came into this course struggling with the subject and left feeling genuinely confident. That transformation is entirely due to Prof. Lee.
The course materials were diverse and representative. I finally saw examples that reflected my own background and experience.
Office hours were offered at multiple times including evenings which made them accessible to students who work or commute.
The only improvement I can suggest is more time on the final two units. They felt slightly rushed compared to earlier topics.
A few of the readings were very dense and could benefit from a brief summary or guide to help students navigate them.
The course could use a few more low stakes assignments early on to help students calibrate before the major projects.
I would have liked more recorded lectures available for review. Rewatching key concepts would have helped my studying significantly.
